home.tagline: Compare contracts clause by clause with AI.
home.description: Add two or more contracts. AI Contrast matches their clauses, shows what is the same and what is different, and rates each difference from the client's point of view.

ratings.title: How differences are rated

green.label: Favorable
green.description: The terms work in the client's favor.

yellow.label: Pay attention
yellow.description: The terms need a careful look.

red.label: Unfavorable
red.description: The terms are unfavorable or risky for the client.

ratings.evidence: Every rating comes with an explanation and a quote from the contract.

home.byok: Start free with the built-in AI model, or connect your own AI provider key. Contract text goes only to the AI provider that processes it.
home.status: Early version: you can add contracts and check the files now. Comparison is coming soon.

upload.title: Contracts to compare
upload.intro: Add each contract with its annexes. Labels A, B, C… follow the order of the contracts.
upload.dropHint: Or drop files here. PDF, DOCX or TXT, up to {{maxSize}} per file, up to {{maxFiles}} files per contract.

google.label: Google Docs link
google.hint: Share the document as “Anyone with the link can view”. For a private document, download it as DOCX or PDF and upload the file.
google.invalid: This is not a Google Docs document link.
google.name: Google Docs document …{{suffix}}

hash.sameFileIn: The same file is in Contract {{label}}
hash.sameTextHere: Same text as another file in this contract
hash.sameTextIn: Same text as a file in Contract {{label}}

errors.length_required: The server could not read the file size. Remove the file and add it again.

file_too_large.detail: The limit is {{maxSize}} per file. Make the file smaller or split it into parts.

errors.request_too_large: The request is too large for the server. Remove the file and add a smaller one.
errors.unsupported_media_type: The server did not accept the upload. Reload the page and add the file again.
errors.empty_file: The file is empty. Choose a file with the contract text.
errors.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported. Use PDF, DOCX or TXT.
errors.legacy_office_unsupported: This is an old Word (.doc) file or a password-protected file. Remove the password if there is one. Save the file as .docx or PDF and try again.
errors.pages_unsupported: Apple Pages files are not supported. Export to PDF: File → Export To → PDF.
errors.archive_rejected: The file is damaged or has an unsafe structure. Open it in Word and save it again, or export it to PDF, then add it again.
errors.length_mismatch: The file did not arrive completely. Try again.
errors.upload_timeout: The upload took too long. Check your connection and try again, or use a smaller file.
errors.busy: The server is busy. Remove the file and add it again in a minute.
errors.network_error: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection, then remove the file and add it again.
errors.timeout: The check took too long. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.aborted: The check was stopped. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.unknown_error: The server gave an unexpected answer. Remove the file and add it again.

too_many_files.reason: Too many files in this contract.
too_many_files.detail: A contract can have at most {{maxFiles}} files. Remove a file first.

total_too_large.reason: The files are too large together.
total_too_large.detail: All files together can be at most {{maxTotal}}. Remove some files first.

errors.extraction_failed: We could not read the text of this file. Open the file, save it again as PDF or DOCX, then add it again.
errors.extraction_timeout: Reading the file took too long. Split it into smaller files or save it as a new PDF, then add it again.
errors.too_many_pages: The file has too many pages. Split it into parts and add them as separate files.
errors.too_much_text: The file has too much text. Split it into parts and add them as separate files.
errors.encrypted_unsupported: The file is password-protected or encrypted. Remove the protection, save the file and add it again.
errors.no_text_extracted: No text was found in the file. Check that this is the contract file and add it again.
errors.text_decoding_failed: The text encoding of the file is not supported. Save the file as UTF-8 text and add it again.
errors.suspicious_package: The file has an unsafe structure. Open it in Word and save it as a new .docx file, or export it to PDF, then add it again.
errors.docx_strict_unsupported: This .docx file uses the Strict Open XML format. In Word, save it again in the standard .docx format, then add it again.
errors.pdf_damaged: The PDF file is damaged. Open it and save or print it to a new PDF, then add it again.
errors.too_many_ocr_pages: This scan has too many pages to recognize. Split it into parts and add them as separate files.
errors.ocr_failed: Text recognition failed. Remove the file and add it again, or add a PDF with selectable text.
errors.duplicate_file: This file is already in this contract. Remove the copy or add a different file.
errors.not_implemented: PDF and Word support is coming. For now, save the contract as a .txt file and add it.
errors.invalid_request: The request was not accepted. Reload the page and add the link again.
errors.invalid_google_doc_id: The document ID in the link is not valid. Check the link, then remove this row and add the link again.
errors.google_doc_not_public: The document is not shared by link. Share it as “Anyone with the link can view”, or download it as DOCX or PDF and upload the file.
errors.google_doc_not_found: The document was not found. Check the link, then remove this row and add the link again.
errors.google_doc_too_large: The document is too large. Download it as DOCX or PDF, split it into parts and upload the parts as separate files.
errors.google_doc_unavailable: Google Docs did not give the document. Try again in a minute, or download it as DOCX or PDF and upload the file.
errors.google_doc_timeout: Google Docs took too long to answer. Try again in a minute, or download it as DOCX or PDF and upload the file.
errors.too_many_clauses: The file has too many clauses. Split it into parts and add them as separate files.
errors.clause_too_long: One clause is too long to process. Split the file into parts and add them as separate files.
errors.segment_timeout: Splitting the text into clauses took too long. Try again, or use a shorter file.
errors.segment_failed: The text could not be split into clauses. Try again, or check the file and add it again.
errors.invalid_response: The server gave an unexpected answer while splitting the text. Try again.
errors.too_many_identifiers: The file has too many identifiers (names, codes, addresses). Split it into parts and add them as separate files.

warning.not_read_altchunk: An embedded document was not read. Check it in the original file.
warning.not_read_object: An embedded object was not read. Check it in the original file.
warning.not_read_subdocument: A linked subdocument was not read. Check it in the original file.
warning.borderline_text: Some text is very small or very light. Check it in the original file.
warning.pdf_edited: The PDF was changed after it was first saved. Make sure this is the final version.
warning.external_reference: The file refers to outside content that was not read. Check it in the original file.
warning.ocr_used: Some pages are scans. The text was recognized automatically and can contain mistakes. Check it in the original file.
warning.ocr_low_confidence: Text recognition was uncertain on some pages. Check them in the original file.
warning.unknown: Some content could not be read. Check it in the original file.
warning.numbering_gap: Clause numbers skip a number. Check that no clause is missing.
warning.numbering_restart: Clause numbering starts again from 1. Check the file structure.
warning.duplicate_number: Two clauses have the same number. Check the file structure.
warning.no_numbering_found: No clause numbers were found. The text is split by paragraphs.
warning.requisites_condition: Clause with requisites: a line with an obligation was kept, check it.
warning.placeholder_lookalike: Text that looks like a placeholder was changed so that it cannot be mistaken for one.
warning.masked_next_to_amount: A masked value stands next to an amount. Check that the amount is still clear.

upload.privacy: Our server checks each file and does not keep it: files are not stored. File names stay in your browser and are never sent.

announce.contractRemoved: Contract {{label}} removed. The labels of the next contracts moved up.

settings.title: Data and history

history.label: Save results in this browser
history.explanation: Results with contract quotes (names replaced by placeholders) are kept in this browser for 90 days and are not encrypted. Do not turn this on on a shared computer.

settings.unavailable: History is not available in this browser.

turnOff.title: Turn off history?
turnOff.message: Saved results will be deleted from this browser. This cannot be undone.

deleteAll.button: Delete all data in this browser
deleteAll.title: Delete all data?
deleteAll.message: Settings, saved results and other data of this app in this browser will be removed. The interface language stays.

notice.deleted: All data in this browser was deleted.
notice.blocked: Close the other tabs of this app, then try again. Deletion finishes when they close.
notice.failed: The data could not be deleted. Try again.

pseudo.title: Check replacements
pseudo.intro: Names and identifiers are replaced by placeholders before any AI call. Check every highlighted text. Nothing leaves your browser until you confirm.
pseudo.cannotUnmask: This value cannot be shown to the AI: it is an identifier or a code.
pseudo.maskRefused: This text cannot be masked: it touches a text that is already marked.
pseudo.clausesTitle: Clauses as the AI will see them
pseudo.premasked: Masked again by the safety check. Confirm again.

neutralized.explanation: The contract text looks like a placeholder. We changed the brackets to ⟦ ⟧ so that it cannot be mistaken for one.
